ⲁⲩⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲡⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲁⲃⲣⲁⲁⲙ ⲡⲉϫⲉ ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉ ⲉⲛⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁⲃⲣⲁⲁⲙ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲓϩⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲁⲃⲣⲁⲁⲙ ⲛⲁⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲁⲓⲧⲟⲩ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲑⲃⲏⲧ ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲛ̀ⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲑⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲓⲥⲟⲑⲙⲉⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙ̀ⲫϯ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉ ⲁⲃⲣⲁⲁⲙ ⲁⲓϥ ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲓⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϩⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲧⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲡⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲛ ϩⲁⲛϫⲫⲟ ⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲡⲟⲣⲛⲓⲁ ⲟⲩⲓⲱⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩⲁⲧϥ ⲉⲧⲉⲛⲧⲁⲛ ⲫϯ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ ϫⲉ ⲉⲛⲉ ⲫϯ ⲡⲉⲧⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲁⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ ⲡⲉ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉⲧⲁⲓⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫϯ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲓⲓ̀ ⲟⲩ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛⲉⲧⲁⲓⲓ̀ ⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲟⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩⲁⲧ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲡⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲁⲟⲩⲟⲓ

items.en: The Departure of St. Epiphanius, Bishop of Cyprus
items.ar: تذكار نياحة القديس ابيفانوس أسقف قبرص

readings.en: God be merciful to us and bless us, And cause His face to shine upon us,Selah That Your way may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
readings.ar: لِيَتَحَنَّنِ ٱللهُ عَلَيْنَا وَلْيُبَارِكْنَا. لِيُنِرْ بِوَجْهِهِ عَلَيْنَا. سِلَاهْ. لِكَيْ يُعْرَفَ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ طَرِيقُكَ، وَفِي كُلِّ ٱلْأُمَمِ خَلَاصُكَ.

readings.en: On the same day, when evening had come, He said to them, "Let us cross over to the other side." Now when they had left the multitude, they took Him along in the boat as He was. And other little boats were also with Him. And a great windstorm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so that it was already filling. But He was in the stern, asleep on a pillow. And they awoke Him and said to Him, "Teacher, do You not care that we are perishing?" Then He arose and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, "Peace, be still!" And the wind ceased and there was a great calm. But He said to them, "Why are you so fearful? How is it that you have no faith?" And they feared exceedingly, and said to one another, "Who can this be, that even the wind and the sea obey Him!"
readings.ar: وَقَالَ لَهُمْ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ لَمَّا كَانَ ٱلْمَسَاءُ: «لِنَجْتَزْ إِلَى ٱلْعَبْرِ». فَصَرَفُوا ٱلْجَمْعَ وَأَخَذُوهُ كَمَا كَانَ فِي ٱلسَّفِينَةِ. وَكَانَتْ مَعَهُ أَيْضًا سُفُنٌ أُخْرَى صَغِيرَةٌ. فَحَدَثَ نَوْءُ رِيحٍ عَظِيمٌ، فَكَانَتِ ٱلْأَمْوَاجُ تَضْرِبُ إِلَى ٱلسَّفِينَةِ حَتَّى صَارَتْ تَمْتَلِئُ. وَكَانَ هُوَ فِي ٱلْمُؤَخَّرِ عَلَى وِسَادَةٍ نَائِمًا. فَأَيْقَظُوهُ وَقَالُوا لَهُ: «يَا مُعَلِّمُ، أَمَا يَهُمُّكَ أَنَّنَا نَهْلِكُ؟». فَقَامَ وَٱنْتَهَرَ ٱلرِّيحَ، وَقَالَ لِلْبَحْرِ: «ٱسْكُتْ! اِبْكَمْ!». فَسَكَنَتِ ٱلرِّيحُ وَصَارَ هُدُوءٌ عَظِيمٌ. وَقَالَ لَهُمْ: «مَا بَالُكُمْ خَائِفِينَ هَكَذَا؟ كَيْفَ لَا إِيمَانَ لَكُمْ؟». فَخَافُوا خَوْفًا عَظِيمًا، وَقَالُوا بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ: «مَنْ هُوَ هَذَا؟ فَإِنَّ ٱلرِّيحَ أَيْضًا وَٱلْبَحْرَ يُطِيعَانِهِ!».

readings.en: Let the peoples praise You, O God; Let all the peoples praise You. Then the earth shall yield her increase; God, our own God, shall bless us. God shall bless us, And all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
readings.ar: يَحْمَدُكَ ٱلشُّعُوبُ يَا ٱللهُ. يَحْمَدُكَ ٱلشُّعُوبُ كُلُّهُمْ. ٱلْأَرْضُ أَعْطَتْ غَلَّتَهَا. يُبَارِكُنَا ٱللهُ إِلَهُنَا. يُبَارِكُنَا ٱللهُ، وَتَخْشَاهُ كُلُّ أَقَاصِي ٱلْأَرْضِ.

readings.en: Now a leper came to Him, imploring Him, kneeling down to Him and saying to Him, "If You are willing, You can make me clean." Then Jesus, moved with compassion, stretched out His hand and touched him, and said to him, "I am willing; be cleansed." As soon as He had spoken, immediately the leprosy left him, and he was cleansed. And He strictly warned him and sent him away at once, and said to him, "See that you say nothing to anyone; but go your way, show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing those things which Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."
readings.ar: فَأَتَى إِلَيْهِ أَبْرَصُ يَطْلُبُ إِلَيْهِ جَاثِيًا وَقَائِلًا لَهُ: «إِنْ أَرَدْتَ تَقْدِرْ أَنْ تُطَهِّرَنِي». فَتَحَنَّنَ يَسُوعُ وَمَدَّ يَدَهُ وَلَمَسَهُ وَقَالَ لَهُ: «أُرِيدُ، فَٱطْهُرْ!». فَلِلْوَقْتِ وَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ ٱلْبَرَصُ وَطَهَرَ. فَٱنْتَهَرَهُ وَأَرْسَلَهُ لِلْوَقْتِ، وَقَالَ لَهُ: «ٱنْظُرْ، لَا تَقُلْ لِأَحَدٍ شَيْئًا، بَلِ ٱذْهَبْ أَرِ نَفْسَكَ لِلْكَاهِنِ وَقَدِّمْ عَنْ تَطْهِيرِكَ مَا أَمَرَ بِهِ مُوسَى، شَهَادَةً لَهُمْ».

readings.en: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God. Therefore by the deeds of the law no flesh will be justified in His sight, for by the law is the knowledge of sin. But now the righteousness of God apart from the law is revealed, being witnessed by the Law and the Prophets,
readings.ar: وَنَحْنُ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّ كُلَّ مَا يَقُولُهُ ٱلنَّامُوسُ فَهُوَ يُكَلِّمُ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي ٱلنَّامُوسِ، لِكَيْ يَسْتَدَّ كُلُّ فَمٍ، وَيَصِيرَ كُلُّ ٱلْعَالَمِ تَحْتَ قِصَاصٍ مِنَ ٱللهِ. لِأَنَّهُ بِأَعْمَالِ ٱلنَّامُوسِ كُلُّ ذِي جَسَدٍ لَا يَتَبَرَّرُ أَمَامَهُ. لِأَنَّ بِٱلنَّامُوسِ مَعْرِفَةَ ٱلْخَطِيَّةِ. وَأَمَّا ٱلْآنَ فَقَدْ ظَهَرَ بِرُّ ٱللهِ بِدُونِ ٱلنَّامُوسِ، مَشْهُودًا لَهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّامُوسِ وَٱلْأَنْبِيَاءِ،

readings.en: Do not marvel, my brethren, if the world hates you. We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love the brethren. He who does not love his brother abides in death. Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him. By this we know love, because He laid down His life for us. And we also ought to lay down our lives for the brethren. But whoever has this world's goods, and sees his brother in need, and shuts up his heart from him, how does the love of God abide in him?
readings.ar: لَا تَتَعَجَّبُوا يَا إِخْوَتِي إِنْ كَانَ ٱلْعَالَمُ يُبْغِضُكُمْ. نَحْنُ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّنَا قَدِ ٱنْتَقَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ إِلَى ٱلْحَيَاةِ، لِأَنَّنَا نُحِبُّ ٱلْإِخْوَةَ. مَنْ لَا يُحِبَّ أَخَاهُ يَبْقَ فِي ٱلْمَوْتِ. كُلُّ مَنْ يُبْغِضُ أَخَاهُ فَهُوَ قَاتِلُ نَفْسٍ، وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ كُلَّ قَاتِلِ نَفْسٍ لَيْسَ لَهُ حَيَاةٌ أَبَدِيَّةٌ ثَابِتَةٌ فِيهِ. بِهَذَا قَدْ عَرَفْنَا ٱلْمَحَبَّةَ: أَنَّ ذَاكَ وَضَعَ نَفْسَهُ لِأَجْلِنَا، فَنَحْنُ يَنْبَغِي لَنَا أَنْ نَضَعَ نُفُوسَنَا لِأَجْلِ ٱلْإِخْوَةِ. وَأَمَّا مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ مَعِيشَةُ ٱلْعَالَمِ، وَنَظَرَ أَخَاهُ مُحْتَاجًا، وَأَغْلَقَ أَحْشَاءَهُ عَنْهُ، فَكَيْفَ تَثْبُتُ مَحَبَّةُ ٱللهِ فِيهِ؟

readings.en: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council. And the high priest asked them, saying, "Did we not strictly command you not to teach in this name? And look, you have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this Man's blood on us!" But Peter and the other apostles answered and said: "We ought to obey God rather than men.
readings.ar: فَلَمَّا أَحْضَرُوهُمْ أَوْقَفُوهُمْ فِي ٱلْمَجْمَعِ. فَسَأَلَهُمْ رَئِيسُ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ قَائِلًا: «أَمَا أَوْصَيْنَاكُمْ وَصِيَّةً أَنْ لَا تُعَلِّمُوا بِهَذَا ٱلِٱسْمِ؟ وَهَا أَنْتُمْ قَدْ مَلَأْتُمْ أُورُشَلِيمَ بِتَعْلِيمِكُمْ، وَتُرِيدُونَ أَنْ تَجْلِبُوا عَلَيْنَا دَمَ هَذَا ٱلْإِنْسَانِ». فَأَجَابَ بُطْرُسُ وَٱلرُّسُلُ وَقَالُوا: «يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُطَاعَ ٱللهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ.

readings.en: Save me, O God, by Your name, And vindicate me by Your strength. Hear my prayer, O God; Give ear to the words of my mouth.
readings.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ، بِٱسْمِكَ خَلِّصْنِي، وَبِقُوَّتِكَ ٱحْكُمْ لِي. ٱسْمَعْ يَا ٱللهُ صَلَاتِي. ٱصْغَ إِلَى كَلَامِ فَمِي.

readings.en: Most assuredly, I say to you, if anyone keeps My word he shall never see death." Then the Jews said to Him, "Now we know that You have a demon! Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and You say, 'If anyone keeps My word he shall never taste death.' Are You greater than our father Abraham, who is dead? And the prophets are dead. Who do You make Yourself out to be?" Jesus answered, "If I honor Myself, My honor is nothing. It is My Father who honors Me, of whom you say that He is your God. Yet you have not known Him, but I know Him. And if I say, 'I do not know Him,' I shall be a liar like you; but I do know Him and keep His word.
readings.ar: اَلْحَقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ: إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدٌ يَحْفَظُ كَلَامِي فَلَنْ يَرَى ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ». فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلْيَهُودُ: ٱلْآنَ عَلِمْنَا أَنَّ بِكَ شَيْطَانًا. قَدْ مَاتَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَٱلْأَنْبِيَاءُ، وَأَنْتَ تَقُولُ: إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدٌ يَحْفَظُ كَلَامِي فَلَنْ يَذُوقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ. أَلَعَلَّكَ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ ٱلَّذِي مَاتَ؟ وَٱلْأَنْبِيَاءُ مَاتُوا. مَنْ تَجْعَلُ نَفْسَكَ؟». أَجَابَ يَسُوعُ: «إِنْ كُنْتُ أُمَجِّدُ نَفْسِي فَلَيْسَ مَجْدِي شَيْئًا. أَبِي هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُمَجِّدُنِي، ٱلَّذِي تَقُولُونَ أَنْتُمْ إِنَّهُ إِلَهُكُمْ، وَلَسْتُمْ تَعْرِفُونَهُ. وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَأَعْرِفُهُ. وَإِنْ قُلْتُ إِنِّي لَسْتُ أَعْرِفُهُ أَكُونُ مِثْلَكُمْ كَاذِبًا، لَكِنِّي أَعْرِفُهُ وَأَحْفَظُ قَوْلَهُ.

days.intro_en:
Vespers Psalm (Psalm 67:1–2): Here the psalmist prays that God may bless us and make His face shine on us, so that all nations may praise Him.
Vespers Gospel (Mark 4:35–41): Here St Mark tells how a great storm arises as the Lord Jesus sleeps in the boat, and how He calms the sea when the frightened disciples wake Him.
Matins Psalm (Psalm 67:5–7): Here the psalmist prays that God may bless us and make His face shine on us, so that all nations may praise Him.
Matins Gospel (Mark 1:40–44): Here a leper kneels before the Lord Jesus and says, "If You are willing, You can make me clean," and the Lord touches and heals him.
Pauline Epistle (Romans 3:19–21): Here St Paul tells the Christians in Rome that the law shows all the world guilty before God, and that God's righteousness is now revealed apart from the law.
Catholic Epistle (1 John 3:13–17): Here St John tells his brethren not to marvel if the world hates them, and to love one another as Christ laid down His life for us.
Praxis (Acts 5:27–29): Here the high priest questions the apostles before the council, and Peter answers, "We ought to obey God rather than men."
Liturgy Psalm (Psalm 54:1–2): Here David asks God to save him by His name when strangers rise against him.
Liturgy Gospel (John 8:51–55): Here the Lord Jesus tells the Jews that whoever keeps His word will never see death, and that He knows the Father and keeps His word.
days.intro_ar:
مزمور العشية (مزامير 67: 1–2): هنا يصلّي صاحب المزمور لكي يباركنا الله ويضيء بوجهه علينا، فتحمده جميع الأمم.
إنجيل العشية (مرقس 4: 35–41): هنا يروي القدّيس مرقس كيف هبّت عاصفة عظيمة والربّ يسوع نائم في السفينة، وكيف أسكت البحر لمّا أيقظه التلاميذ الخائفون.
مزمور باكر (مزامير 67: 5–7): هنا يصلّي صاحب المزمور لكي يباركنا الله ويضيء بوجهه علينا، فتحمده جميع الأمم.
إنجيل باكر (مرقس 1: 40–44): هنا يجثو أبرص أمام الربّ يسوع قائلًا: «إن أردت تقدر أن تطهّرني»، فيلمسه الربّ ويشفيه.
البولس (رومية 3: 19–21): هنا يقول القدّيس بولس للمسيحيّين في رومية إنّ الناموس يُظهر العالم كلّه تحت قصاص من الله، وإنّ برّ الله ظهر الآن بدون الناموس.
الكاثوليكون (1 يوحنا 3: 13–17): هنا يقول القدّيس يوحنا لإخوته ألّا يتعجّبوا إن أبغضهم العالم، وأن يحبّوا بعضهم بعضًا كما وضع المسيح نفسه لأجلنا.
الإبركسيس (اعمال 5: 27–29): هنا يستجوب رئيس الكهنة الرسل أمام المجمع، فيجيب بطرس: «ينبغي أن يُطاع الله أكثر من الناس».
مزمور القداس (مزامير 54: 1–2): هنا يطلب داود النبيّ من الله أن يخلّصه باسمه حين قام عليه الغرباء.
إنجيل القداس (يوحنا 8: 51–55): هنا يقول الربّ يسوع لليهود إنّ من يحفظ كلامه لن يرى الموت إلى الأبد، وإنّه يعرف الآب ويحفظ قوله.

"Most assuredly, I say to you, if anyone keeps My word he shall never see death." The Jews say, "Now we know that You have a demon! Romans 3: "by the deeds of the law no flesh will be justified in His sight, for by the law is the knowledge of sin. But now the righteousness of God apart from the law is revealed." The law shows our sickness; Christ is the cure, giving life that death cannot end.

«الحق الحق أقول لكم: إن كان أحد يحفظ كلامي فلن يرى الموت إلى الأبد». فيقول اليهود: «الآن علمنا أن بك شيطانًا! قد مات إبراهيم والأنبياء، وأنت تقول... لن يذوق الموت». فيجيب يسوع: «إن كنت أمجّد نفسي فليس مجدي شيئًا. أبي هو الذي يمجّدني... ولستم تعرفونه، وأما أنا فأعرفه».

وفي رومية 3: «بأعمال الناموس كل ذي جسد لا يتبرر أمامه، لأن بالناموس معرفة الخطية. وأما الآن فقد ظهر بر الله بدون الناموس». فالناموس يكشف مرضنا، والمسيح هو الشفاء، معطيًا حياة لا ينهيها الموت.

notes.en: "Never see death" means the believer passes through physical death into life with Christ.
notes.ar: «لن يرى الموت» تعني أن المؤمن يعبر الموت الجسدي إلى الحياة مع المسيح.

saints.name_en: The Departure of St. Epiphanius, Bishop of Cyprus
saints.name_ar: تذكار نياحة القديس ابيفانوس أسقف قبرص

parts.en: On this day of the year 119 of the martyrs (403 A.D.) the great father St. Epiphanius, bishop of Cyprus, departed. He was born about the year 307 A.D. to Jewish parents in Palestine. His father died, left a great wealth and left him and his sister and their mother brought them up well.
parts.ar: في مثل هذا اليوم من سنة 119 للشهداء (403م) تنيح الآب العظيم القديس أبيفانوس أسقف قبرص. ولد نحو 307م من أبوين يهوديين بفلسطين. توفي والده وتركه مع أخت له فقامت أمه بتربيته أحسن تربية وكان والده قد ترك ثروة كبيرة.

parts.en: Once, when he was walking in the road, he saw a poor man asking for alms and he did not pay attention to him. He asked one of the monks, and the monk took off his garment and gave it to him since he did not have anything else to give him. St. Epiphanius saw a white dress coming down from heaven upon the monk instead of the garment that he gave away. Epiphanius marveled and went to the monk and asked him about his faith. The monk told him that he was Christian. He asked the monk to guide him to the facts of this religion. The monk brought him to the bishop of the region who taught and exhorted him then baptized him.
parts.ar: وحدث مرة وهو سائر في الطريق أنه أبصر فقيرا يطلب صدقة فلم يهتم به. بينما ابصر احد الرهبان يخلع ثوبه ويعطيه للفقير لانه لم يكن غيره. في هذا الوقت رأى أبيفانوس كأن حلة بيضاء نزلت من السماء على هذا الراهب عوض الثوب. تعجب من ذلك وأنطلق الي الراهب وسأله عن ايمانه. فأعلمه انه مسيحي. فطلب اليه أن يرشده الي حقائق هذا الدين فاجابه الي طلبه واتي به الى أسقف الجهة فعلمه ووعظه ثم عمده.

parts.en: Epiphanius desired the monastic life, so the bishop sent him to the monastery of St. Lucianus. He became a disciple to St. Hilarion who prophesied that he would be a bishop. He learned Hebrew, Coptic, Syrian, Greek, and Latin and also studied the Holy Bible. St. Jerome called him, “He who has five tongues.”
parts.ar: بعد ذلك أشتاق للرهبنة فأرسله الأسقف الى دير القديس " لوقيانوس " فتتلمذ على يدي القديس ايلاريون الذي تنبا عنه انه سيصير أسقفا. تعلم العبرية والقبطية والسريانية واليونانية واللاتينية و درس الكتاب المقدس، لذا دعاه القديس جيروم: "صاحب الخمسة ألسنة ".

parts.en: Because he loved the life of asceticism and contemplation, he left Palestine and went to Egypt about the year 335 A.D. where he met a group of hermits and monks before his seclusion in a monastery in Alexandria.
parts.ar: واذ كان محبا لحياة النسك والتامل ترك فلسطين الى مصر نحو سنة 335م ليلتقى بمجموعة من النساك والرهبان قبل أعتزاله في دير الأسكندرية.

parts.en: Some Gnostics felt his abilities, gifts and desires and wanted to recruit him. They sent to him some adulterous women to entice him but with the grace of God he did not fall into sin. For this reason he dedicated a great deal of his power to refute the heretics.
parts.ar: اذ شعر بعض الغنوسيين بقدراته ومواهبه واشتياقاته ارادوا كسبه. فأرسلوا اليه بعض الزانيات ينصبن له فخاخا لكنه بنعمة الله لم يسقط في الخطية. ومن هنا ندرك السبب الذي لأجله كرس طاقاته للرد على الهراطقة.

parts.en: He established a monastery in Palestine and he was very stern with himself. One of his disciples asked him, how could he endure this asceticism that exceeds his strength? He replied; “God does not grant us the kingdom unless we struggle, and all what we endure does not compare to the crown that we are struggling for.”
parts.ar: أسس ديرا في فلسطين وكان حازما جدا مع نفسه. وحدث أن سأله أحد تلاميذه كيف يحتمل هذا النسك الذي يفوق قوته؟ أجابه " الله لا يهبنا الملكوت ما لم نجاهد وكل ما نحتمله لا يتناسب مع الاكليل الذي نجاهد من اجله ".

parts.en: The bishop of the city realized the effort of St. Epiphanius among his people who gathered around him seeking his advice and blessings. He ordained him a priest to make more use of his talents. Meanwhile, St. Hilarion left the area for multitudes of people gathered around him and went to Cyprus. The bishops, priests and the people came to receive his blessing. He talked to them about St. Epiphanius, his asceticism, virtues, knowledge and his zeal. When the bishop of the city of Salamis on the island of Cyprus reposed, they chose him a bishop for it, against his will, in the year 367 A.D.
parts.ar: شعر أسقف المدينة بدور القديس ابيفانوس وسط شعبه الذي التف حوله يطلب ارشاداته وبركته فرسمه كاهنا لكى تزداد المنفعة به. فى هذه الفترة ترك ايلاريون المنطقة بسبب تجمهر الناس حوله وذهب الى قبرص فجاء اليه الأساقفة والكهنة والشعب يطلبون بركته فتحدث اليهم عن ابيفانيوس ونسكه وفضائله وعلمه وغيرته، ولما تنيح أسقف سلاميس بجزيرة قبرص انتخبوا أبيفانيوس أسقفا عليها بغير ارادته عام 367م.

parts.en: St. Epiphanius was distinguished with his ardent zeal and firmness toward the Orthodox faith with great love for the poor. He used to give whatever he had in the Episcopal place; however God sent to him much more to give to the poor. The widow St. Olympias granted him endowments for that purpose. His love for the poor was the main reason for him accepting the Christian faith as we had seen earlier. Once his disciple asked him to put a limit to the giving since there was nothing left. Right after this conversation a stranger came and gave the bishop a sack of gold and immediately disappeared. In his biography it was mentioned that a deceiver came to ask for alms to bury his friend and he gave him. When he returned to his friend he found him in fact dead.
parts.ar: تميز ابيفانيوس بغيرته وحزمه بخصوص الايمان المستقيم مع حب شديد للفقراء حتى أنه لم يكن يترك فى دار الاسقفية أحيانا شيئا قط، ومع ذلك فقد كان الله يرسل له الكثير جدا ليوزعه. فقد منحته الارملة القديسة أولمبياس أراضى ومالا لهذا الغرض. ولعل محبته للفقراء قد نبعت عن أنها هى علة قبوله الايمان المسيحى كما رأينا. قيل ان تلميذه طلب منه مرة أن يضع حدا لهذا العطاء إذ لم يعد معهما شئ، وبعد هذا الحديث تقدم إنسان غريب وقدم كيسا من الذهب للاسقف واختفى فى الحال. جاء فى سيرته أن أحد المخادعين جاء يسأله صدقه ليكفن صديقه فأعطاه ولما ذهب لصديقه وجده قد مات حقاً.

parts.en: St. Epiphanius departed when he was about ninety six years old.
parts.ar: تنيح القديس أبيفانيوس وله من العمر حوالى ست وتسعين سنه.

parts.en: He had many sayings on asceticism and morality, to mention a few:
parts.ar: وله أقوال كثيره فى النسك والفضيله منها:

parts.en: (1) Reading the Holy Bible is a great security against sin and the ignorance of the Holy Scriptures is a bottomless pit and a great gulf.
parts.ar: قراءة الكتب المقدسة أمان عظيم ضد الخطية، والجهل بها هاوية عميقة وهوة عظيمة.

parts.en: (2) Do not love the things of the world, you will have rest and joy at the last day. Keep away from the pleasures of the world so you will not be overcome with the grief of the devils.
parts.ar: لا تحبوا متاع الدنيا فتستريحوا وتفرحوا فى الاخرة. وتحفظوا من لذات العالم فلا يقوى عليكم وجع الشياطين.

parts.en: (3) Keep your heart alert by mentioning God and that will ease the attacks of the enemy against you.
parts.ar: أيقظوا قلوبكم بذكر الله، فتخف قتالات الاعداء عنكم.

parts.en: (4) God sells righteousness very cheap for those who want to buy: with a small piece of bread, humble clothes, a cup of cold water or one mite.
parts.ar: الله يبيع البر بثمن بخس للغايه للذين يريدون أن يشتروه بقطعه خبز صغيرة، بثوب وضيع، بكأس ماء بارد بفلس واحد.

parts.en: The blessing of his prayers be with us all and glory be to our God for ever. Amen.
parts.ar: بركة صلواته فلتكن معنا. ولربنا المجد دائما أبديا آمين.

parts.en: St Epiphanius, Bishop of Cyprus, was born around 307 to Jewish parents in Palestine. Seeing a monk give his only garment to a beggar whom Epiphanius himself had ignored, he saw a white robe come down from heaven upon the monk. Amazed, he asked about his faith, was taught by the bishop and baptized. He teaches that generosity is a powerful witness.
parts.ar: وُلد القديس أبيفانيوس أسقف قبرص نحو سنة 307م لأبوين يهوديين في فلسطين. ورأى راهبًا يعطي ثوبه الوحيد لفقير كان أبيفانيوس قد تجاهله، فرأى ثوبًا أبيض ينزل من السماء على الراهب. فتعجّب وسأله عن إيمانه، فعلّمه الأسقف وعمّده. يعلّمنا أن الكرم شهادة قوية.

parts.en: Notice the poor person others ignore.
parts.ar: انتبه للفقير الذي يتجاهله الآخرون.

coptic.t: ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲫϯ: ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩϫⲱⲣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲉϥϫⲁϫⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲫⲱⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁ ⲡⲉϥϩⲟ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲑⲙⲟⲥϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ. ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲙⲟⲩⲛⲕ ⲙ̀ⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲭⲣⲉⲙⲧⲥ ⲁϥϣⲁⲛⲙⲟⲩⲛⲕ. ⲙ̀ⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲟⲩⲗϩ ⲉ̀ϣⲁϥⲃⲱⲗ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁ ⲡϩⲟ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲭⲣⲱⲙ: ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁ ⲡϩⲟ ⲙ̀ⲫϯ.

ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲉⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲉⲧⲁ ⲣⲟⲩϩⲓ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ϫⲉ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲥⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲙⲏⲣ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲭⲁ ⲡⲓⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲁⲩⲟⲗϥ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲟⲩ ϩⲱϥ ϩⲓ ⲡⲓϫⲟⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲣⲉ ϩⲁⲛⲕⲉⲉϫⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁ ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲑⲏⲟⲩ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲓϫⲟⲗ ⲛⲁⲩϩⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓϫⲟⲓ ϩⲱⲥⲧⲉ ϩⲏⲇⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲙⲟϩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓϫⲟⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲛⲁϥⲛⲕⲟⲧ ϩⲓⲫⲁϩⲟⲩ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓϣϣⲟⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲛⲉϩⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉ ⲫⲣⲉϥϯⲥⲃⲱ ⲥⲉⲣⲙⲉⲗⲓⲛ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲁⲛ ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲉⲡⲓⲧⲓⲙⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲑⲏⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲙ̀ⲫⲓⲟⲙ ϫⲉ ⲭⲁⲣⲱⲕ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲑⲱⲙ ⲛ̀ⲣⲱⲕ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲕⲏⲛ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲑⲏⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ϫⲁⲙⲏ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲟⲩ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣϩⲟϯ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲧⲉ ⲛⲁϩϯ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲉⲣϩⲟϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ϩⲟϯ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲩϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲉⲣⲏⲟⲩ ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲙ ϩⲁⲣⲁ ⲡⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲑⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲫⲓⲟⲙ ⲥⲉⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲛⲁϥ

ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲟⲣⲫⲁⲛⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲫⲣⲉϥϯϩⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲭⲏⲣⲁ. ⲫϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲙⲁ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲫϯ ϣⲁϥⲑⲣⲉ ϩⲁⲛⲥⲙⲟⲧ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲧ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲏⲓ. ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϩⲱⲟⲩⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲇⲉⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲧϫⲱⲣⲓ. ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϯϫⲱⲛⲧ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲙϩⲁⲩ. ⲫϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡϫⲓⲛⲑⲣⲉⲕⲥⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲗⲁⲟⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡϫⲓⲛⲑⲣⲉⲕⲥⲓⲛⲓ ϩⲓ ⲡϣⲁϥⲉ:

items.en: The Commemoration of the feast of Pentecost
items.ar: تذكار عيد العنصرة

items.en: The Departure of St. George (Ga'orgi), the Friend of St. Abraam
items.ar: نياحة القديس جورجى رفيق القديس أبرام

readings.en: Remember the word to Your servant, Upon which You have caused me to hope. This is my comfort in my affliction, For Your word has given me life.
readings.ar: اُذْكُرْ لِعَبْدِكَ ٱلْقَوْلَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلْتَنِي أَنْتَظِرُهُ. هَذِهِ هِيَ تَعْزِيَتِي فِي مَذَلَّتِي، لِأَنَّ قَوْلَكَ أَحْيَانِي.

readings.en: Now when evening came, the boat was in the middle of the sea; and He was alone on the land. Then He saw them straining at rowing, for the wind was against them. Now about the fourth watch of the night He came to them, walking on the sea, and would have passed them by. And when they saw Him walking on the sea, they supposed it was a ghost, and cried out; for they all saw Him and were troubled. But immediately He talked with them and said to them, "Be of good cheer! It is I; do not be afraid." Then He went up into the boat to them, and the wind ceased. And they were greatly amazed in themselves beyond measure, and marveled. For they had not understood about the loaves, because their heart was hardened.
readings.ar: وَلَمَّا صَارَ ٱلْمَسَاءُ كَانَتِ ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فِي وَسْطِ ٱلْبَحْرِ، وَهُوَ عَلَى ٱلْبَرِّ وَحْدَهُ. وَرَآهُمْ مُعَذَّبِينَ فِي ٱلْجَذْفِ، لِأَنَّ ٱلرِّيحَ كَانَتْ ضِدَّهُمْ. وَنَحْوَ ٱلْهَزِيعِ ٱلرَّابِعِ مِنَ ٱللَّيْلِ أَتَاهُمْ مَاشِيًا عَلَى ٱلْبَحْرِ، وَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَتَجَاوَزَهُمْ. فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ مَاشِيًا عَلَى ٱلْبَحْرِ ظَنُّوهُ خَيَالًا، فَصَرَخُوا. لِأَنَّ ٱلْجَمِيعَ رَأَوْهُ وَٱضْطَرَبُوا. فَلِلْوَقْتِ كَلَّمَهُمْ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ: «ثِقُوا! أَنَا هُوَ. لَا تَخَافُوا». فَصَعِدَ إِلَيْهِمْ إِلَى ٱلسَّفِينَةِ فَسَكَنَتِ ٱلرِّيحُ، فَبُهِتُوا وَتَعَجَّبُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ جِدًّا إِلَى ٱلْغَايَةِ، لِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَفْهَمُوا بِٱلْأَرْغِفَةِ إِذْ كَانَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ غَلِيظَةً.

readings.en: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, And I shall keep it to the end. Give me understanding, and I shall keep Your law; Indeed, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
readings.ar: عَلِّمْنِي يَارَبُّ طَرِيقَ فَرَائِضِكَ، فَأَحْفَظَهَا إِلَى ٱلنِّهَايَةِ. فَهِّمْنِي فَأُلَاحِظَ شَرِيعَتَكَ، وَأَحْفَظَهَا بِكُلِّ قَلْبِي.

readings.en: Then His brothers and His mother came, and standing outside they sent to Him, calling Him. And a multitude was sitting around Him; and they said to Him, "Look, Your mother and Your brothers are outside seeking You." But He answered them, saying, "Who is My mother, or My brothers?" And He looked around in a circle at those who sat about Him, and said, "Here are My mother and My brothers! For whoever does the will of God is My brother and My sister and mother."
readings.ar: فَجَاءَتْ حِينَئِذٍ إِخْوَتُهُ وَأُمُّهُ وَوَقَفُوا خَارِجًا وَأَرْسَلُوا إِلَيْهِ يَدْعُونَهُ. وَكَانَ ٱلْجَمْعُ جَالِسًا حَوْلَهُ، فَقَالُوا لَهُ: «هُوَذَا أُمُّكَ وَإِخْوَتُكَ خَارِجًا يَطْلُبُونَكَ». فَأَجَابَهُمْ قَائِلًا: «مَنْ أُمِّي وَإِخْوَتِي؟». ثُمَّ نَظَرَ حَوْلَهُ إِلَى ٱلْجَالِسِينَ وَقَالَ: «هَا أُمِّي وَإِخْوَتِي، لِأَنَّ مَنْ يَصْنَعُ مَشِيئَةَ ٱللهِ هُوَ أَخِي وَأُخْتِي وَأُمِّي».

readings.en: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off have been brought near by the blood of Christ. For He Himself is our peace, who has made both one, and has broken down the middle wall of separation, having abolished in His flesh the enmity, that is, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, so as to create in Himself one new man from the two, thus making peace, and that He might reconcile them both to God in one body through the cross, thereby putting to death the enmity. And He came and preached peace to you who were afar off and to those who were near. For through Him we both have access by one Spirit to the Father.
readings.ar: وَلَكِنِ ٱلْآنَ فِي ٱلْمَسِيحِ يَسُوعَ، أَنْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنْتُمْ قَبْلًا بَعِيدِينَ، صِرْتُمْ قَرِيبِينَ بِدَمِ ٱلْمَسِيحِ. لِأَنَّهُ هُوَ سَلَامُنَا، ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلِٱثْنَيْنِ وَاحِدًا، وَنَقَضَ حَائِطَ ٱلسِّيَاجِ ٱلْمُتَوَسِّطَ، أَيِ ٱلْعَدَاوَةَ. مُبْطِلًا بِجَسَدِهِ نَامُوسَ ٱلْوَصَايَا فِي فَرَائِضَ، لِكَيْ يَخْلُقَ ٱلِٱثْنَيْنِ فِي نَفْسِهِ إِنْسَانًا وَاحِدًا جَدِيدًا، صَانِعًا سَلَامًا، وَيُصَالِحَ ٱلِٱثْنَيْنِ فِي جَسَدٍ وَاحِدٍ مَعَ ٱللهِ بِٱلصَّلِيبِ، قَاتِلًا ٱلْعَدَاوَةَ بِهِ. فَجَاءَ وَبَشَّرَكُمْ بِسَلَامٍ، أَنْتُمُ ٱلْبَعِيدِينَ وَٱلْقَرِيبِينَ. لِأَنَّ بِهِ لَنَا كِلَيْنَا قُدُومًا فِي رُوحٍ وَاحِدٍ إِلَى ٱلْآبِ.

readings.en: And above all things have fervent love for one another, for "love will cover a multitude of sins." Be hospitable to one another without grumbling. As each one has received a gift, minister it to one another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God. If anyone speaks, let him speak as the oracles of God. If anyone ministers, let him do it as with the ability which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen. Beloved, do not think it strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened to you; but rejoice to the extent that you partake of Christ's sufferings, that when His glory is revealed, you may also be glad with exceeding joy.
readings.ar: وَلَكِنْ قَبْلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، لِتَكُنْ مَحَبَّتُكُمْ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ شَدِيدَةً، لِأَنَّ ٱلْمَحَبَّةَ تَسْتُرُ كَثْرَةً مِنَ ٱلْخَطَايَا. كُونُوا مُضِيفِينَ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا بِلَا دَمْدَمَةٍ. لِيَكُنْ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ بِحَسَبِ مَا أَخَذَ مَوْهِبَةً، يَخْدِمُ بِهَا بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا، كَوُكَلَاءَ صَالِحِينَ عَلَى نِعْمَةِ ٱللهِ ٱلْمُتَنَوِّعَةِ. إِنْ كَانَ يَتَكَلَّمُ أَحَدٌ فَكَأَقْوَالِ ٱللهِ. وَإِنْ كَانَ يَخْدِمُ أَحَدٌ فَكَأَنَّهُ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ يَمْنَحُهَا ٱللهُ، لِكَيْ يَتَمَجَّدَ ٱللهُ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ بِيَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ، ٱلَّذِي لَهُ ٱلْمَجْدُ وَٱلسُّلْطَانُ إِلَى أَبَدِ ٱلْآبِدِينَ. آمِينَ. أَيُّهَا ٱلْأَحِبَّاءُ، لَا تَسْتَغْرِبُوا ٱلْبَلْوَى ٱلْمُحْرِقَةَ ٱلَّتِي بَيْنَكُمْ حَادِثَةٌ، لِأَجْلِ ٱمْتِحَانِكُمْ، كَأَنَّهُ أَصَابَكُمْ أَمْرٌ غَرِيبٌ، بَلْ كَمَا ٱشْتَرَكْتُمْ فِي آلَامِ ٱلْمَسِيحِ، ٱفْرَحُوا لِكَيْ تَفْرَحُوا فِي ٱسْتِعْلَانِ مَجْدِهِ أَيْضًا مُبْتَهِجِينَ.

readings.en: After the uproar had ceased, Paul called the disciples to himself, embraced them, and departed to go to Macedonia. Now when he had gone over that region and encouraged them with many words, he came to Greece and stayed three months. And when the Jews plotted against him as he was about to sail to Syria, he decided to return through Macedonia. And Sopater of Berea accompanied him to Asia--also Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia. These men, going ahead, waited for us at Troas. But we sailed away from Philippi after the Days of Unleavened Bread, and in five days joined them at Troas, where we stayed seven days.
readings.ar: وَبَعْدَمَا ٱنْتَهَى ٱلشَّغَبُ، دَعَا بُولُسُ ٱلتَّلَامِيذَ وَوَدَّعَهُمْ، وَخَرَجَ لِيَذْهَبَ إِلَى مَكِدُونِيَّةَ. وَلَمَّا كَانَ قَدِ ٱجْتَازَ فِي تِلْكَ ٱلنَّوَاحِي وَوَعَظَهُمْ بِكَلَامٍ كَثِيرٍ، جَاءَ إِلَى هَلَّاسَ، فَصَرَفَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ. ثُمَّ إِذْ حَصَلَتْ مَكِيدَةٌ مِنَ ٱلْيَهُودِ عَلَيْهِ، وَهُوَ مُزْمِعٌ أَنْ يَصْعَدَ إِلَى سُورِيَّةَ، صَارَ رَأْيٌ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ عَلَى طَرِيقِ مَكِدُونِيَّةَ. فَرَافَقَهُ إِلَى أَسِيَّا سُوبَاتَرُسُ ٱلْبِيرِيُّ، وَمِنْ أَهْلِ تَسَالُونِيكِي: أَرَسْتَرْخُسُ وَسَكُونْدُسُ وَغَايُوسُ ٱلدَّرْبِيُّ وَتِيمُوثَاوُسُ. وَمِنْ أَهْلِ أَسِيَّا: تِيخِيكُسُ وَتُرُوفِيمُسُ. هَؤُلَاءِ سَبَقُوا وَٱنْتَظَرُونَا فِي تَرُوَاسَ. وَأَمَّا نَحْنُ فَسَافَرْنَا فِي ٱلْبَحْرِ بَعْدَ أَيَّامِ ٱلْفَطِيرِ مِنْ فِيلِبِّي، وَوَافَيْنَاهُمْ فِي خَمْسَةِ أَيَّامٍ إِلَى تَرُوَاسَ، حَيْثُ صَرَفْنَا سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ.

readings.en: For God is my King from of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth. You divided the sea by Your strength; You broke the heads of the sea serpents in the waters. Arise, O God, plead Your own cause; Remember how the foolish man reproaches You daily. Do not forget the voice of Your enemies; The tumult of those who rise up against You increases continually.
readings.ar: وَٱللهُ مَلِكِي مُنْذُ ٱلْقِدَمِ، فَاعِلُ ٱلْخَلَاصِ فِي وَسَطِ ٱلْأَرْضِ. أَنْتَ شَقَقْتَ ٱلْبَحْرَ بِقُوَّتِكَ. كَسَرْتَ رُؤُوسَ ٱلتَّنَانِينِ عَلَى ٱلْمِيَاهِ. قُمْ يَا ٱللهُ. أَقِمْ دَعْوَاكَ. ٱذْكُرْ تَعْيِيرَ ٱلْجَاهِلِ إِيَّاكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ. لَا تَنْسَ صَوْتَ أَضْدَادِكَ، ضَجِيجَ مُقَاوِمِيكَ ٱلصَّاعِدَ دَائِمًا.

readings.en: Now about the middle of the feast Jesus went up into the temple and taught. And the Jews marveled, saying, "How does this Man know letters, having never studied?" Jesus answered them and said, "My doctrine is not Mine, but His who sent Me. If anyone wills to do His will, he shall know concerning the doctrine, whether it is from God or whether I speak on My own authority. He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory; but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is true, and no unrighteousness is in Him. Did not Moses give you the law, yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill Me?" The people answered and said, "You have a demon. Who is seeking to kill You?" Jesus answered and said to them, "I did one work, and you all marvel. Moses therefore gave you circumcision (not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers), and you circumcise a man on the Sabbath. If a man receives circumcision on the Sabbath, so that the law of Moses should not be broken, are you angry with Me because I made a man completely well on the Sabbath? Do not judge according to appearance, but judge with righteous judgment." Now some of them from Jerusalem said, "Is this not He whom they seek to kill? But look! He speaks boldly, and they say nothing to Him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is truly the Christ? However, we know where this Man is from; but when the Christ comes, no one knows where He is from." Then Jesus cried out, as He taught in the temple, saying, "You both know Me, and you know where I am from; and I have not come of Myself, but He who sent Me is true, whom you do not know. But I know Him, for I am from Him, and He sent Me."
readings.ar: وَلَمَّا كَانَ ٱلْعِيدُ قَدِ ٱنْتَصَفَ، صَعِدَ يَسُوعُ إِلَى ٱلْهَيْكَلِ، وَكَانَ يُعَلِّمُ. فَتَعَجَّبَ ٱلْيَهُودُ قَائِلِينَ: «كَيْفَ هَذَا يَعْرِفُ ٱلْكُتُبَ، وَهُوَ لَمْ يَتَعَلَّمْ؟». أَجَابَهُمْ يَسُوعُ وَقَالَ: «تَعْلِيمِي لَيْسَ لِي بَلْ لِلَّذِي أَرْسَلَنِي. إِنْ شَاءَ أَحَدٌ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ مَشِيئَتَهُ يَعْرِفُ ٱلتَّعْلِيمَ، هَلْ هُوَ مِنَ ٱللهِ، أَمْ أَتَكَلَّمُ أَنَا مِنْ نَفْسِي. مَنْ يَتَكَلَّمُ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ يَطْلُبُ مَجْدَ نَفْسِهِ، وَأَمَّا مَنْ يَطْلُبُ مَجْدَ ٱلَّذِي أَرْسَلَهُ فَهُوَ صَادِقٌ وَلَيْسَ فِيهِ ظُلْمٌ. أَلَيْسَ مُوسَى قَدْ أَعْطَاكُمُ ٱلنَّامُوسَ؟ وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ يَعْمَلُ ٱلنَّامُوسَ! لِمَاذَا تَطْلُبُونَ أَنْ تَقْتُلُونِي؟» أَجَابَ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَقَالُوا: «بِكَ شَيْطَانٌ. مَنْ يَطْلُبُ أَنْ يَقْتُلَكَ؟». أَجَابَ يَسُوعُ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ: «عَمَلًا وَاحِدًا عَمِلْتُ فَتَتَعَجَّبُونَ جَمِيعًا. لِهَذَا أَعْطَاكُمْ مُوسَى ٱلْخِتَانَ، لَيْسَ أَنَّهُ مِنْ مُوسَى، بَلْ مِنَ ٱلْآبَاءِ. فَفِي ٱلسَّبْتِ تَخْتِنُونَ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ. فَإِنْ كَانَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ يَقْبَلُ ٱلْخِتَانَ فِي ٱلسَّبْتِ، لِئَلَّا يُنْقَضَ نَامُوسُ مُوسَى، أَفَتَسْخَطُونَ عَلَيَّ لِأَنِّي شَفَيْتُ إِنْسَانًا كُلَّهُ فِي ٱلسَّبْتِ؟ لَا تَحْكُمُوا حَسَبَ ٱلظَّاهِرِ بَلِ ٱحْكُمُوا حُكْمًا عَادِلًا». فَقَالَ قَوْمٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ أُورُشَلِيمَ: «أَلَيْسَ هَذَا هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَطْلُبُونَ أَنْ يَقْتُلُوهُ؟ وَهَا هُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ جِهَارًا وَلَا يَقُولُونَ لَهُ شَيْئًا! أَلَعَلَّ ٱلرُّؤَسَاءَ عَرَفُوا يَقِينًا أَنَّ هَذَا هُوَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ حَقًّا؟ وَلَكِنَّ هَذَا نَعْلَمُ مِنْ أَيْنَ هُوَ، وَأَمَّا ٱلْمَسِيحُ فَمَتَى جَاءَ لَا يَعْرِفُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَيْنَ هُوَ». فَنَادَى يَسُوعُ وَهُوَ يُعَلِّمُ فِي ٱلْهَيْكَلِ قَائِلًا: «تَعْرِفُونَنِي وَتَعْرِفُونَ مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنَا، وَمِنْ نَفْسِي لَمْ آتِ، بَلِ ٱلَّذِي أَرْسَلَنِي هُوَ حَقٌّ، ٱلَّذِي أَنْتُمْ لَسْتُمْ تَعْرِفُونَهُ. أَنَا أَعْرِفُهُ لِأَنِّي مِنْهُ، وَهُوَ أَرْسَلَنِي».

days.intro_en:
Vespers Psalm (Psalm 119:49,50): Here the psalmist speaks to the Lord of his love for His word and commandments, a lamp to his feet and a light to his path.
Vespers Gospel (Mark 6:47–52): Here St Mark tells how the Lord Jesus comes to His disciples walking on the sea, calms the wind, and they are amazed because their hearts were hardened.
Matins Psalm (Psalm 119:33–34): Here the psalmist speaks to the Lord of his love for His word and commandments, a lamp to his feet and a light to his path.
Matins Gospel (Mark 3:31–35): Here the Lord Jesus is told His mother and brothers are outside, and He says that whoever does God's will is His brother, sister and mother.
Pauline Epistle (Ephesians 2:13–18): Here St Paul tells the Christians of Ephesus that Christ is our peace, who broke down the wall between Jews and Gentiles.
Catholic Epistle (1 Peter 4:8–13): Here St Peter tells the Christians to have fervent love and hospitality, and to rejoice in sharing the sufferings of Christ.
Praxis (Acts 20:1–6): Here St Luke tells how Paul encourages the disciples and travels through Macedonia and Greece with his companions to Troas.
Liturgy Psalm (Psalm 74:12,13,22,23): Here Asaph pleads with God for His ruined sanctuary, recalling that God is his King from of old.
Liturgy Gospel (John 7:14–29): Here the Lord Jesus teaches in the temple that His doctrine is from God, and tells the people of Jerusalem that He is from the Father who sent Him.
days.intro_ar:
مزمور العشية (مزامير 119: 49، 50): هنا يكلّم صاحب المزمور الربّ عن محبّته لكلمته ووصاياه، سراجًا لرجليه ونورًا لسبيله.
إنجيل العشية (مرقس 6: 47–52): هنا يروي القدّيس مرقس كيف أتى الربّ يسوع إلى تلاميذه ماشيًا على البحر وسكّن الريح، فاندهشوا لأنّ قلوبهم كانت غليظة.
مزمور باكر (مزامير 119: 33–34): هنا يكلّم صاحب المزمور الربّ عن محبّته لكلمته ووصاياه، سراجًا لرجليه ونورًا لسبيله.
إنجيل باكر (مرقس 3: 31–35): هنا يُقال للربّ يسوع إنّ أمّه وإخوته خارجًا، فيقول إنّ من يصنع مشيئة الله هو أخوه وأخته وأمّه.
البولس (افسس 2: 13–18): هنا يقول القدّيس بولس لأهل أفسس إنّ المسيح هو سلامنا، الذي نقض حائط السياج المتوسّط بين اليهود والأمم.
الكاثوليكون (1 بطرس 4: 8–13): هنا يقول القدّيس بطرس للمسيحيّين أن تكون لهم محبّة شديدة وإضافة للغرباء، وأن يفرحوا بالاشتراك في آلام المسيح.
الإبركسيس (اعمال 20: 1–6): هنا يروي القدّيس لوقا كيف شجّع بولس التلاميذ وجال في مكدونية واليونان مع رفاقه حتّى ترواس.
مزمور القداس (مزامير 74: 12، 13، 22، 23): هنا يتوسّل آساف إلى الله من أجل مقدسه الخرب، متذكّرًا أنّ الله ملكه منذ القدم.
إنجيل القداس (يوحنا 7: 14–29): هنا يعلّم الربّ يسوع في الهيكل أنّ تعليمه من الله، ويقول لأهل أورشليم إنّه من الآب الذي أرسله.

In the middle of the Feast of Tabernacles Jesus teaches in the temple, and the people marvel: "How does this Man know letters, having never studied?" He says, "My doctrine is not Mine, but His who sent Me. If anyone wills to do His will, he shall know concerning the doctrine." "Do not judge according to appearance, but judge with righteous judgment." Some ask whether the rulers know He is the Christ.

Ephesians 2: "now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off have been brought near by the blood of Christ. For He Himself is our peace, who has made both one, and has broken down the middle wall of separation." Doing God's will is the way to understand His teaching.

في وسط عيد المظال يعلّم يسوع في الهيكل، فيتعجب الناس: «كيف هذا يعرف الكتب وهو لم يتعلم؟» فيقول: «تعليمي ليس لي بل للذي أرسلني. إن شاء أحد أن يعمل مشيئته يعرف التعليم». «لا تحكموا حسب الظاهر، بل احكموا حكمًا عادلًا». ويتساءل بعضهم هل عرف الرؤساء أنه المسيح.

وفي أفسس 2: «ولكن الآن في المسيح يسوع أنتم الذين كنتم قبلًا بعيدين صرتم قريبين بدم المسيح. لأنه هو سلامنا، الذي جعل الاثنين واحدًا، ونقض حائط السياج المتوسط». وعمل مشيئة الله هو الطريق لفهم تعليمه.

notes.en: Understanding the faith grows through obeying it, not only studying it.
notes.ar: فهم الإيمان ينمو بطاعته، لا بدراسته فقط.

saints.name_en: The Commemoration of the feast of Pentecost
saints.name_ar: تذكار عيد العنصرة

parts.en: This day marks the commemoration of the coming down of the Holy Spirit upon the holy disciples in the upper room of Zion in Jerusalem. “When the day of Pentecost had fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a rushing mighty wind, and filled the whole house where they were sitting. Then there appeared to them divided tongues, as of fire, and one sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit.”
parts.ar: تعيد الكنيسة فى هذا اليوم بتذكار حلول الروح القدس على التلاميذ الاطهار فى علية صهيون بأورشليم " فبينما كان الجميع معا بنفس واحدة صار بغتة من السماء صوت كما من هبوب ريح عاصفة وملأ كل البيت حيث كانوا جالسين وظهرت لهم السنة من نار وأستقرت على كل واحده منهم وأمتلئ الجميع من الروح القدس (أع 2: 1 – 4).

parts.en: The blessing of this holy feast be with us all. Amen.
parts.ar: بركة هذا العيد المقدس فلتكن معنا آمين.

parts.en: The Synaxarium commemorates the coming of the Holy Spirit on the disciples in the upper room: "suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a rushing mighty wind... divided tongues, as of fire... And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit." It teaches that the Spirit empowers the Church.
parts.ar: يذكر السنكسار حلول الروح القدس على التلاميذ في العلية: «وصار بغتة من السماء صوت كما من هبوب ريح عاصفة... ألسنة منقسمة كأنها من نار... وامتلأ الجميع من الروح القدس». ويعلّمنا أن الروح يقوّي الكنيسة.

parts.en: Ask the Holy Spirit to fill and guide you.
parts.ar: اطلب من الروح القدس أن يملأك ويرشدك.

saints.name_en: The Departure of St. George (Ga'orgi), the Friend of St. Abraam
saints.name_ar: نياحة القديس جورجى رفيق القديس أبرام

parts.en: On this day also of the year 409 of the martyrs (693 A.D.) St. George (Ga'orgi), who was the friend of St. Abraam, departed. He was born to godly Christian parents, and he tended the sheep of his father. He loved the life of contemplation and seclusion and he fasted all daylong and distributed his food among the shepherds. God supported and increased him in godliness.
parts.ar: وفيه أيضاً من سنة 409 للشهداء (693م) تنيح القديس جورجى رفيق القديس أبرام. ولد من أبوين مسيحيين قديسين وكان يرعى غنم أبيه. أحب حياة التأمل وكان يصوم طوال اليوم ويوزع طعامه على الرعاة، وكان الله يعضده وينميه فى الفضيلة.

parts.en: He longed for the monastic life, so he left the tending of the sheep. He was fourteen years old when he went to the wilderness of St. Macarius. On his way he saw a pillar of light guiding him so he rejoiced and was comforted. The light disappeared and the devil appeared to him in the form of an old man who said to him: "Your father thought that a lion had killed you while tending to the sheep, and he rent his garment and grieved over you. Now it is meet that you should return to your father to comfort his heart first for it is written; “Honor your father and mother” then return to the wilderness." The young man replied saying it is written: “He who loves father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me." Immediately that old man became like smoke and disappeared. George realized that it was a devilish deception and he offered thanks to God.
parts.ar: مال الى الرهبنة فترك الغنم وهو فى الرابعة عشرة من عمره وقصد برية القديس مكاريوس. وفى الطريق رأى عمود نور يرشده ففرح وتعزى. أختفى النور ليظهر له أنسان عجوز يقول له:" لقد عبرت أحدى المدن فوجدت رجلا مشقوق الثياب ينوح ويبكى بشدة ويصرخ بصوت عظيم قائلا: إن الاسد قد أفترس أبنى وهو يرعى الغنم واغلب الظن أنه أبوك فعليك أن ترجع وتطيب قلبه لانه مكتوب: "أكرم أباك وأمك (خر 20: 12) ثم تعود الى البرية ". أجاب الشاب قائلا مكتوب:" من أحب أباً أو أماً أكثر منى فلا يستحقنى (مت 10: 37) للحال صار ذلك الشيخ دخاناً وأختفى فعرف جورجى أنها خدعة شيطانية فقدم الشكر لله.

parts.en: Immediately, Archangel Gabriel appeared to him in the form of a young man who guided him to the mountain of Abba Orion (Arion) nearby Shiheet (Scetis). He remained there under the guidance of a holy monk for ten years, during which he did not eat any cooked food or fruits. He kept long vigils in prayers and contemplation in the Holy Scripture until he memorized fourteen books of the Holy Bible. Because of his austere asceticism he was worthy of the company of angelic power to comfort and encourage him.
parts.ar: عندئذ ظهر له الملاك غبريال على شكل صبى صغير حسن الصورة وبهى الملبس رافقه فى الطريق حتى بلغ جبل الانبا أوريون بقرب برية شيهيت. وهناك تتلمذ تحت يدي راهب قديس مدة عشرة سنوات لم يذق فيها طعاما مطبوخا أو فاكهة وكان يقيم الليل كله فى الصلاة والهذيذ فى الكتب حتى حفظ أربعة عشر سفر من اسفار الكتاب المقدس ولكثرة جهاداته أستحق أن تؤانسه قوة ملائكية تعزيه وتشجعه.

parts.en: Then he desired to live in seclusion so he went to the inner wilderness. Two saints appeared to him and told him; “This is not the will of God for you,” accordingly he returned to his place. With God’s providence the Holy Father Anba Abraam came to the mountain of St. Orion where he met St. George (Ga'orgi). They conversed with each other about the wonders of God and they felt a spiritual closeness in their lives and wishes. They decided to live together to support each other. They went to the church to pray and spent all night seeking the Divine Providence for their decision. It was said that St. John the Baptist appeared to them and commanded them to dwell together in the Scetis of St. Macarius
parts.ar: رغب مرة فى التوحد المطلق أو السياحة فدخل الى البرية الداخلية فظهر له أثنان من القديسين وقالا له: ان هذه ليست ارادة الرب بالنسبة لك فرجع الى موضعه. وحدث بعدها بتدبير من الله أن أتى الى جبل أوريون القديس الأنبا أبرآم حيث التقى بالقديس جورجى وتحدثا معا بعجائب الله وشعرا باتفاق روحى فى حياتهما واشتياقهما فرايا ان يعيشا معا يسند احدهما الاخر ذهبا الى الكنيسه للصلاه وبقيا طوال الليل يطلبان مشورة الله من جهة قرارهما فقيل ان القديس يوحنا المعمدان ظهر لهما وطلب منهما ان يعيشا معا فى اسقيط مكاريوس.

parts.en: St. Ga’orgi received the blessings of the fathers, left the mount of St. Orion and went to Shiheet. Anba Abraam had left before him to prepare a place for him. Anba Abraam introduced St. George to his teacher the Holy Father Anba Yoannis, the hegumen of the wilderness of Shiheet. They dwelt together in the cell known as Bigeeg beside the cell of Anba Yoannis.
parts.ar: ترك الانبا جورجى جبل اوريون بعد ان نال بركة الاباء وأنطلق الى الاسقيط وكان قد سبقه الانبا أبرآم ليعد له مكانا وهناك عرفه الانبا أبرآم بمعلمه القديس الانبا يوأنس قمص برية شيهيت.

parts.en: This cell remained one of the sights of the monastery until the fourteenth century when Pope Benjamin II, 82nd Patriarch (1327-1339 A.D.) had visited this cell.
parts.ar: سكنا معا فى قلاية بيجيج بجوار قلاية الانبا يوأنس وقد ظلت هذه القلاية من معالم الدير حتى القرن الرابع عشر حيث زارها البابا بنيامين الثانى البطريرك الثاني والثمانون.

parts.en: They lived together with the spirit of friendship encouraging each other. Later on Anba Abraam became ill for eighteen years during which he suffered from the severe pain. St. George served, prayed for him and read to him the Holy Scriptures until he departed in peace. Shortly after less than five months his brother St. George departed. He was seventy two years old and was buried beside his beloved brother Anba Abraam.
parts.ar: عاشا معا بروح الصداقة القائمة على الحب ويشجعان بعضهما البعض حتى مرض الانبا أبرآم وبقى مدة ثمانية عشر سنة يعانى من قسوة الألم وكان القديس جورجى يخدمه ويصلي من أجله ويقرأ له الكتب المقدسة حتى تنيح. وبعدها بأقل من خمسة أشهر رقد أخوه القديس جورجى بعد أن بلغ من العمر أثنين وسبعين سنة ودفن مع أخيه الحميم الانبا أبرام.

parts.en: The blessing of their prayers be with us all and glory be to our God forever. Amen.
parts.ar: بركة صلوات القديس جورجى فلتكن معنا. ولربنا المجد دائما أبديا آمين.

parts.en: St George (Ga'orgi), friend of St Abraam, tended his father's sheep, fasted all day and gave his food to the shepherds. At fourteen he left for the wilderness of St Macarius, guided by a pillar of light. The devil appeared as an old man saying his father thought a lion had killed him and he should go back first. He teaches discerning temptations that look good.
parts.ar: كان القديس جاورجي، صديق القديس أبرآم، يرعى غنم أبيه، ويصوم النهار كله ويوزّع طعامه على الرعاة. وفي الرابعة عشرة ذهب إلى برية القديس مقاريوس، يرشده عمود نور. فظهر له الشيطان في هيئة شيخ قائلًا إن أباه ظن أن أسدًا افترسه، وإنه يجب أن يرجع أولًا. يعلّمنا تمييز التجارب التي تبدو صالحة.

parts.en: Not every voice that sounds kind is from God; test it.
parts.ar: ليس كل صوت يبدو لطيفًا هو من الله؛ امتحنه.

ϩⲏⲇⲏ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲧⲁ ⲡⲓϣⲁⲓ ⲉⲣⲫⲁϣⲓ ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉ̀ϩⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲉⲣⲫⲉⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁϥϯⲥⲃⲱ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲁⲩⲉⲣϣⲫⲏⲣⲓ ⲟⲩⲛ ⲡⲉ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲓⲟⲩⲇⲁⲓ ⲉⲩϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲡⲱⲥ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲛ̀ⲥϧⲁⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲥⲁⲃⲟ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ϫⲉ ⲧⲁⲥⲃⲱ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲑⲱⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲧⲉ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲉⲣⲫⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲙ̀ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲁⲟⲩⲟⲓ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲥⲟⲩⲉⲛ ⲧⲁⲥⲃⲱ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫϯ ⲧⲉ ϣⲁⲛ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲡⲉⲧⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲟⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩⲁⲧ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩⲁⲧϥ ⲁϥⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ ⲡⲉϥⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲓⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲫⲏ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲧⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ ⲡⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲁⲟⲩⲟϥ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲁ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ ⲙⲏ ⲙⲱⲩⲥⲏⲥ ⲁⲛ ⲁϥϯ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲛⲟⲙⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ϩⲗⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ⲉϥⲓⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲛⲟⲙⲟⲥ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲟⲩ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲑⲃⲉⲧ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲇⲉ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲏϣ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲇⲉⲙⲱⲛ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲕ ⲛⲓⲙ ⲡⲉⲧⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱⲕ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲑⲃⲉⲕ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩϩⲱⲃ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲧ ⲡⲉⲧⲁⲓⲁⲓϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣϣⲫⲏⲣⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲫⲁⲓ ⲁ ⲙⲱⲩⲥⲏⲥ ϯ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲉⲃⲓ ⲟⲩⲭ ⲟⲧⲓ ϫⲉ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲙⲱⲩⲥⲏⲥ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲥⲉⲃⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲓⲟϯ ⲡⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲥⲉⲃⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲥⲁⲃⲃⲁⲧⲟⲛ ⲓⲥϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲁϭⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲉⲃⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲥⲁⲃⲃⲁⲧⲟⲛ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥⲃⲱⲗ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲛⲟⲙⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲙⲱⲩⲥⲏⲥ ⲓⲉ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲟⲩ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛϫⲱⲛⲧ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲓ ϫⲉ ⲁⲓⲑⲣⲉ ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲥⲁⲃⲃⲁⲧⲟⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣϯϩⲁⲡ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ϩⲟ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲙⲁϩⲁⲡ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩϩⲁⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛⲁⲩϫⲱ ⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲡⲉ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ϩⲁⲛⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲁ ⲓⲗ̅ⲏ̅ⲙ̅ ϫⲉ ⲙⲏ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲡⲉ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱϥ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲑⲃⲉϥ ϩⲏⲡⲡⲉ ϥⲥⲁϫⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲡⲁⲣⲣⲏⲥⲓⲁ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲥⲉϫⲉ ϩⲗⲓ ⲛⲁϥ ⲁⲛ ⲙⲏⲡⲱⲥ ⲣⲱ ⲁⲩⲉⲙⲓ ⲧⲁⲫⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ϫⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲑⲱⲛ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲇⲉ ⲁϥϣⲁⲛⲓ̀ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ϩⲗⲓ ⲛⲁⲉⲙⲓ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲑⲱⲛ ⲡⲉ ⲁϥⲱϣ ⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲉⲣⲫⲉⲓ ⲉϥϯⲥⲃⲱ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲙⲓ ϫⲉ ⲉⲧⲁⲓⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲑⲱⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲉⲧⲁⲓⲓ̀ ⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲟⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩⲁⲧ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲟⲩⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲁⲟⲩⲟⲓ ⲫⲏ ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲉⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲁⲛ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲇⲉ ϯⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲫⲏ ⲡⲉ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲁⲟⲩⲟⲓ

items.en: The Departure of Abba Isaac, the Priest of El-Qalali (Cells)
items.ar: نياحة القديس الأنبا أسحق قس القلالى

items.en: The Martyrdom of St. Isidorus (Isidore) of Antioch
items.ar: أستشهاد القديس أيسوذورس الانطاكي

readings.en: It is vain for you to rise up early, To sit up late, To eat the bread of sorrows; For so He gives His beloved sleep. Behold, children are a heritage from the LORD, The fruit of the womb is a reward.
readings.ar: بَاطِلٌ هُوَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُبَكِّرُوا إِلَى ٱلْقِيَامِ، مُؤَخِّرِينَ ٱلْجُلُوسَ، آكِلِينَ خُبْزَ ٱلْأَتْعَابِ. لَكِنَّهُ يُعْطِي حَبِيبَهُ نَوْمًا. هُوَذَا ٱلْبَنُونَ مِيرَاثٌ مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱلرَّبِّ، ثَمَرَةُ ٱلْبَطْنِ أُجْرَةٌ.

readings.en: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes came together to Him, having come from Jerusalem. Now when they saw some of His disciples eat bread with defiled, that is, with unwashed hands, they found fault. For the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they wash their hands in a special way, holding the tradition of the elders. When they come from the marketplace, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other things which they have received and hold, like the washing of cups, pitchers, copper vessels, and couches.
readings.ar: وَٱجْتَمَعَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْفَرِّيسِيُّونَ وَقَوْمٌ مِنَ ٱلْكَتَبَةِ قَادِمِينَ مِنْ أُورُشَلِيمَ. وَلَمَّا رَأَوْا بَعْضًا مِنْ تَلَامِيذِهِ يَأْكُلُونَ خُبْزًا بِأَيْدٍ دَنِسَةٍ، أَيْ غَيْرِ مَغْسُولَةٍ، لَامُوا. لِأَنَّ ٱلْفَرِّيسِيِّينَ وَكُلَّ ٱلْيَهُودِ إِنْ لَمْ يَغْسِلُوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ بِٱعْتِنَاءٍ، لَا يَأْكُلُونَ، مُتَمَسِّكِينَ بِتَقْلِيدِ ٱلشُّيُوخِ. وَمِنَ ٱلسُّوقِ إِنْ لَمْ يَغْتَسِلُوا لَا يَأْكُلُونَ. وَأَشْيَاءُ أُخْرَى كَثِيرَةٌ تَسَلَّمُوهَا لِلتَّمَسُّكِ بِهَا، مِنْ غَسْلِ كُؤُوسٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَآنِيَةِ نُحَاسٍ وَأَسِرَّةٍ.

readings.en: Let all be put to shame who serve carved images, Who boast of idols. Worship Him, all you gods. Zion hears and is glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoice Because of Your judgments, O LORD.
readings.ar: يَخْزَى كُلُّ عَابِدِي تِمْثَالٍ مَنْحُوتٍ، ٱلْمُفْتَخِرِينَ بِٱلْأَصْنَامِ. ٱسْجُدُوا لَهُ يَا جَمِيعَ ٱلْآلِهَةِ. سَمِعَتْ صِهْيَوْنُ فَفَرِحَتْ، وَٱبْتَهَجَتْ بَنَاتُ يَهُوذَا مِنْ أَجْلِ أَحْكَامِكَ يَارَبُّ.

readings.en: Also He said to them, "Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Is it not to be set on a lampstand? For there is nothing hidden which will not be revealed, nor has anything been kept secret but that it should come to light. If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear." Then He said to them, "Take heed what you hear. With the same measure you use, it will be measured to you; and to you who hear, more will be given. For whoever has, to him more will be given; but whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him."
readings.ar: ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُمْ: «هَلْ يُؤْتَى بِسِرَاجٍ لِيُوضَعَ تَحْتَ ٱلْمِكْيَالِ أَوْ تَحْتَ ٱلسَّرِيرِ؟ أَلَيْسَ لِيُوضَعَ عَلَى ٱلْمَنَارَةِ؟ لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ خَفِيٌّ لَا يُظْهَرُ، وَلَا صَارَ مَكْتُومًا إِلَّا لِيُعْلَنَ. إِنْ كَانَ لِأَحَدٍ أُذُنَانِ لِلسَّمْعِ، فَلْيَسْمَعْ». وَقَالَ لَهُمُ: «ٱنْظُرُوا مَا تَسْمَعُونَ! بِٱلْكَيْلِ ٱلَّذِي بِهِ تَكِيلُونَ يُكَالُ لَكُمْ وَيُزَادُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلسَّامِعُونَ. لِأَنَّ مَنْ لَهُ سَيُعْطَى، وَأَمَّا مَنْ لَيْسَ لَهُ فَٱلَّذِي عِنْدَهُ سَيُؤْخَذُ مِنْهُ».

readings.en: But now the righteousness of God apart from the law is revealed, being witnessed by the Law and the Prophets, even the righteousness of God, through faith in Jesus Christ, to all and on all who believe. For there is no difference; for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God, being justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus, whom God set forth as a propitiation by His blood, through faith, to demonstrate His righteousness, because in His forbearance God had passed over the sins that were previously committed, to demonstrate at the present time His righteousness, that He might be just and the justifier of the one who has faith in Jesus.
readings.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْآنَ فَقَدْ ظَهَرَ بِرُّ ٱللهِ بِدُونِ ٱلنَّامُوسِ، مَشْهُودًا لَهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّامُوسِ وَٱلْأَنْبِيَاءِ، بِرُّ ٱللهِ بِٱلْإِيمَانِ بِيَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ، إِلَى كُلِّ وَعَلَى كُلِّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ. لِأَنَّهُ لَا فَرْقَ. إِذِ ٱلْجَمِيعُ أَخْطَأُوا وَأَعْوَزَهُمْ مَجْدُ ٱللهِ، مُتَبَرِّرِينَ مَجَّانًا بِنِعْمَتِهِ بِٱلْفِدَاءِ ٱلَّذِي بِيَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ، ٱلَّذِي قَدَّمَهُ ٱللهُ كَفَّارَةً بِٱلْإِيمَانِ بِدَمِهِ، لِإِظْهَارِ بِرِّهِ، مِنْ أَجْلِ ٱلصَّفْحِ عَنِ ٱلْخَطَايَا ٱلسَّالِفَةِ بِإِمْهَالِ ٱللهِ، لِإِظْهَارِ بِرِّهِ فِي ٱلزَّمَانِ ٱلْحَاضِرِ، لِيَكُونَ بَارًّا وَيُبَرِّرَ مَنْ هُوَ مِنَ ٱلْإِيمَانِ بِيَسُوعَ.

readings.en: My little children, let us not love in word or in tongue, but in deed and in truth. And by this we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before Him. For if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things. Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have confidence toward God. And whatever we ask we receive from Him, because we keep His commandments and do those things that are pleasing in His sight. And this is His commandment: that we should believe on the name of His Son Jesus Christ and love one another, as He gave us commandment. Now he who keeps His commandments abides in Him, and He in him. And by this we know that He abides in us, by the Spirit whom He has given us.
readings.ar: يَا أَوْلَادِي، لَا نُحِبَّ بِٱلْكَلَامِ وَلَا بِٱللِّسَانِ، بَلْ بِٱلْعَمَلِ وَٱلْحَقِّ! وَبِهَذَا نَعْرِفُ أَنَّنَا مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَنُسَكِّنُ قُلُوبَنَا قُدَّامَهُ. لِأَنَّهُ إِنْ لَامَتْنَا قُلُوبُنَا فَٱللهُ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ قُلُوبِنَا، وَيَعْلَمُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ. أَيُّهَا ٱلْأَحِبَّاءُ، إِنْ لَمْ تَلُمْنَا قُلُوبُنَا، فَلَنَا ثِقَةٌ مِنْ نَحْوِ ٱللهِ. وَمَهْمَا سَأَلْنَا نَنَالُ مِنْهُ، لِأَنَّنَا نَحْفَظُ وَصَايَاهُ، وَنَعْمَلُ ٱلْأَعْمَالَ ٱلْمَرْضِيَّةَ أَمَامَهُ. وَهَذِهِ هِيَ وَصِيَّتُهُ: أَنْ نُؤْمِنَ بِٱسْمِ ٱبْنِهِ يَسُوعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ، وَنُحِبَّ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا كَمَا أَعْطَانَا وَصِيَّةً. وَمَنْ يَحْفَظْ وَصَايَاهُ يَثْبُتْ فِيهِ وَهُوَ فِيهِ. وَبِهَذَا نَعْرِفُ أَنَّهُ يَثْبُتُ فِينَا: مِنَ ٱلرُّوحِ ٱلَّذِي أَعْطَانَا.

readings.en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus whom you murdered by hanging on a tree. Him God has exalted to His right hand to be Prince and Savior, to give repentance to Israel and forgiveness of sins. And we are His witnesses to these things, and so also is the Holy Spirit whom God has given to those who obey Him." When they heard this, they were furious and plotted to kill them.
readings.ar: إِلَهُ آبَائِنَا أَقَامَ يَسُوعَ ٱلَّذِي أَنْتُمْ قَتَلْتُمُوهُ مُعَلِّقِينَ إِيَّاهُ عَلَى خَشَبَةٍ. هَذَا رَفَّعَهُ ٱللهُ بِيَمِينِهِ رَئِيسًا وَمُخَلِّصًا، لِيُعْطِيَ إِسْرَائِيلَ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ وَغُفْرَانَ ٱلْخَطَايَا. وَنَحْنُ شُهُودٌ لَهُ بِهَذِهِ ٱلْأُمُورِ، وَٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْقُدُسُ أَيْضًا، ٱلَّذِي أَعْطَاهُ ٱللهُ لِلَّذِينَ يُطِيعُونَهُ». فَلَمَّا سَمِعُوا حَنِقُوا، وَجَعَلُوا يَتَشَاوَرُونَ أَنْ يَقْتُلُوهُمْ.

readings.en: God be merciful to us and bless us, And cause His face to shine upon us,Selah Then the earth shall yield her increase; God, our own God, shall bless us. God shall bless us, And all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
readings.ar: لِيَتَحَنَّنِ ٱللهُ عَلَيْنَا وَلْيُبَارِكْنَا. لِيُنِرْ بِوَجْهِهِ عَلَيْنَا. سِلَاهْ. ٱلْأَرْضُ أَعْطَتْ غَلَّتَهَا. يُبَارِكُنَا ٱللهُ إِلَهُنَا. يُبَارِكُنَا ٱللهُ، وَتَخْشَاهُ كُلُّ أَقَاصِي ٱلْأَرْضِ.

readings.en: Jesus answered, "If I honor Myself, My honor is nothing. It is My Father who honors Me, of whom you say that He is your God. Yet you have not known Him, but I know Him. And if I say, 'I do not know Him,' I shall be a liar like you; but I do know Him and keep His word. Your father Abraham rejoiced to see My day, and he saw it and was glad." Then the Jews said to Him, "You are not yet fifty years old, and have You seen Abraham?" Jesus said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, before Abraham was, I AM." Then they took up stones to throw at Him; but Jesus hid Himself and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
readings.ar: أَجَابَ يَسُوعُ: «إِنْ كُنْتُ أُمَجِّدُ نَفْسِي فَلَيْسَ مَجْدِي شَيْئًا. أَبِي هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُمَجِّدُنِي، ٱلَّذِي تَقُولُونَ أَنْتُمْ إِنَّهُ إِلَهُكُمْ، وَلَسْتُمْ تَعْرِفُونَهُ. وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَأَعْرِفُهُ. وَإِنْ قُلْتُ إِنِّي لَسْتُ أَعْرِفُهُ أَكُونُ مِثْلَكُمْ كَاذِبًا، لَكِنِّي أَعْرِفُهُ وَأَحْفَظُ قَوْلَهُ. أَبُوكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمُ تَهَلَّلَ بِأَنْ يَرَى يَوْمِي فَرَأَى وَفَرِحَ». فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلْيَهُودُ: «لَيْسَ لَكَ خَمْسُونَ سَنَةً بَعْدُ، أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ؟». قَالَ لَهُمْ يَسُوعُ: «ٱلْحَقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ: قَبْلَ أَنْ يَكُونَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَنَا كَائِنٌ». فَرَفَعُوا حِجَارَةً لِيَرْجُمُوهُ. أَمَّا يَسُوعُ فَٱخْتَفَى وَخَرَجَ مِنَ ٱلْهَيْكَلِ مُجْتَازًا فِي وَسْطِهِمْ وَمَضَى هَكَذَا.

days.intro_en:
Vespers Psalm (Psalm 127:2–3): Here King Solomon tells the people that unless the Lord builds the house, they labour in vain, and that children are a gift from the Lord.
Vespers Gospel (Mark 7:1–4): Here St Mark explains to his readers the Pharisees' customs of washing, as they gather to question the Lord Jesus.
Matins Psalm (Psalm 97:7–8): Here the psalmist proclaims that the Lord reigns, and tells the righteous that light is sown for them.
Matins Gospel (Mark 4:21–25): Here the Lord Jesus tells His disciples that a lamp is meant to be set on a lampstand, and to take heed how they hear.
Pauline Epistle (Romans 3:21–26): Here St Paul tells the Christians in Rome that all have sinned and are justified freely by God's grace through the redemption in Christ Jesus.
Catholic Epistle (1 John 3:18–24): Here St John tells his little children to love not only in word but in deed and truth, and to believe in the name of Jesus Christ.
Praxis (Acts 5:30–33): Here Peter and the apostles tell the council that God raised up Jesus whom they killed, and the council, furious, plots to kill them.
Liturgy Psalm (Psalm 67:1,6,7): Here the psalmist prays that God may bless us and make His face shine on us, so that all nations may praise Him.
Liturgy Gospel (John 8:54–59): Here the Lord Jesus tells the Jews, "Before Abraham was, I AM," and they take up stones, but He passes through their midst.
days.intro_ar:
مزمور العشية (مزامير 127: 2–3): هنا يقول الملك سليمان للشعب إنّه إن لم يبنِ الربّ البيت فباطلًا يتعبون، وإنّ البنين ميراث من عند الربّ.
إنجيل العشية (مرقس 7: 1–4): هنا يشرح القدّيس مرقس لقرّائه عادات الفرّيسيّين في الغسل، إذ اجتمعوا ليسائلوا الربّ يسوع.
مزمور باكر (مزامير 97: 7–8): هنا يعلن صاحب المزمور أنّ الربّ قد ملك، ويقول للأبرار إنّ النور قد أشرق لهم.
إنجيل باكر (مرقس 4: 21–25): هنا يقول الربّ يسوع لتلاميذه إنّ السراج يوضع على المنارة، وإنّ عليهم أن ينتبهوا كيف يسمعون.
البولس (رومية 3: 21–26): هنا يقول القدّيس بولس للمسيحيّين في رومية إنّ الجميع أخطأوا ويتبرّرون مجّانًا بنعمة الله بالفداء الذي بيسوع المسيح.
الكاثوليكون (1 يوحنا 3: 18–24): هنا يقول القدّيس يوحنا لأولاده أن يحبّوا لا بالكلام فقط بل بالعمل والحقّ، وأن يؤمنوا باسم يسوع المسيح.
الإبركسيس (اعمال 5: 30–33): هنا يقول بطرس والرسل للمجمع إنّ الله أقام يسوع الذي قتلوه، فيغتاظ المجمع ويتشاور على قتلهم.
مزمور القداس (مزامير 67: 1، 6، 7): هنا يصلّي صاحب المزمور لكي يباركنا الله ويضيء بوجهه علينا، فتحمده جميع الأمم.
إنجيل القداس (يوحنا 8: 54–59): هنا يقول الربّ يسوع لليهود: «قبل أن يكون إبراهيم أنا كائن»، فيرفعون حجارة، لكنّه يجتاز في وسطهم.

Jesus says, "Your father Abraham rejoiced to see My day, and he saw it and was glad." The Jews say, "You are not yet fifty years old, and have You seen Abraham?" Romans 3: all "are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus, whom God set forth as a propitiation by His blood, through faith." "Before Abraham was, I AM" – Jesus claims the eternal name of God; the eternal Son became man to redeem us.
